predict.question: Your habit tracker follows a fixed rule: each time a reminder cue appears, it logs two completed actions. The cue appears once each round for four rounds. How many actions get logged?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: The Power of Habit describes routines in relation to cues and rewards.
modelBoundary: Keeping the cue records {A}; removing it records {B}. The programmed trigger supplies actions; no habit strength is inferred.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real cues do not guarantee actions; rewards and competing cues are outside this counter.
